chain.owner: the run-root claim file, re-read and nonce-checked
the Work owner, via the journal TRIAL_RECORDED attemptId

runIdentitySource: the run journal RUN_STARTED record, read by readRunIdentity(); a missing, malformed or conflicting run identity is refused
attemptIdentitySource: prepared.attemptId, captured at the host-private delegation boundary; never a caller claim and never reported by the model

durableRecord.contentDigest: sha256 over the record excluding recordDigest

law: a fabricated JSON object is a test fixture and does not become trusted evidence because the schema is valid; the record is trusted only to the extent the local host process that produced it is trusted
